verses.2: May Jehovah never forget me forever. May He hide His face from me.
verses.3: Until then, I will keep these words in my heart. They will be with me forever. Until then, my enemies will not be able to harm me.
verses.4: The Lord, my God, has darkened my eyes, so that no one can see.
verses.5: Then he will say, “My enemies can do whatever they want. My troubles will be revealed, for I am the One who knows everything.”
verses.6: And in your grace, I trust that my heart will be saved through your salvation. I will serve the LORD, for He has forgiven me.
